referenceFunction.generalComment: Disposal of various components for a ventilation system with a nominal air flow rate of 5'000-20'000 m3/h at the air handling unit. The reference value of the inventory is 1 m2 heated gross floor area. The inventory is based on average data of 4 office buildings, 3 schools and 3 residential care homes with a total heated gross floor area of 61719 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 302190 m3/h, specific weight of the components: 0.84 kg/m2, including average components for air valves, air intake, roof-hoods, dampers, fire dampers, silencers and sensors. The data represent a ventilation system mainly made of galvanized steel.; UUID: c16363ac-dfb1-4415-8c61-7b87a4d13023
